issue_summary: A source-document or activity row was rejected during evidence ingestion.
recommended_action: Review the rejection code and message, correct the source evidence or metadata, and ingest the record again.
allowed_use: The rejection record may be retained as an audit trail of unsuccessful ingestion.
prohibited_use: Do not use a rejected row in normalization, factor matching, emissions calculation, or reporting.

issue_summary: The activity value is missing, non-numeric, non-finite, zero, or negative.
recommended_action: Verify the source document and enter a finite activity value greater than zero.
allowed_use: The original evidence may remain visible for investigation.
prohibited_use: Do not use the invalid value in unit conversion or emissions calculation.

issue_summary: The activity unit is missing or blank.
recommended_action: Verify the source document and provide the correct activity unit.
allowed_use: The original evidence may remain visible for investigation.
prohibited_use: Do not match factors or calculate emissions without a valid unit.

issue_summary: No supported core-pipeline rule exists for the activity type.
recommended_action: Review the activity classification and add a controlled, tested rule only when the activity type and required method are understood.
allowed_use: The activity may remain visible as unresolved evidence.
prohibited_use: Do not guess a canonical unit, factor, or emissions result.

issue_summary: The unit cannot be converted safely using the registered engineering conversions.
recommended_action: Verify the source unit and add a documented conversion dependency or explicit conversion rule when supported by evidence.
allowed_use: The original activity quantity and unit may remain visible.
prohibited_use: Do not perform an undocumented engineering conversion.

issue_summary: Emissions calculation is blocked because a required conversion dependency has not been verified.
recommended_action: Obtain and register the required verified conversion evidence before calculation.
allowed_use: The activity, factor candidates, and blocking dependency may remain visible for data collection and review.
prohibited_use: Do not report zero emissions and do not invent a heating value or conversion.

issue_summary: Multiple conflicting heating values match the activity year.
recommended_action: Review official heating-value evidence and keep only one verified row for that fuel and year.
allowed_use: The conflicting rows may remain visible for review.
prohibited_use: Do not silently choose the newest heating value or report a calculated result.

issue_summary: CO2, CH4, and N2O factors are not all present for this combustion activity.
recommended_action: Register the missing gas-specific factor from the same official factor version before calculation.
allowed_use: The partial factor set may remain visible.
prohibited_use: Do not calculate a partial CO2e total from an incomplete gas set.

issue_summary: CO2/CH4/N2O factors do not belong to one official source and version family.
recommended_action: Select a consistent official factor version before calculation.
allowed_use: The inconsistent factor group may remain visible for review.
prohibited_use: Do not mix factor versions across gases or report a calculated result.

issue_summary: A unique combustion GWP record could not be confirmed for this activity.
recommended_action: Confirm the official GWP table and emission context before calculation.
prohibited_use: Do not use fossil-methane GWP 30 for fuel combustion or report zero emissions.

issue_summary: No suitable emissions factor is configured for the activity.
recommended_action: Determine the intended calculation method, evidence quality requirements, and an appropriate documented factor before calculation.
allowed_use: The activity quantity may remain visible as an identified emissions-data gap.
prohibited_use: Do not replace the missing result with zero or an undocumented fallback factor.

issue_summary: The calculation layer received an invalid normalized value or unit.
recommended_action: Resolve the upstream normalization problem and regenerate the calculation result.
allowed_use: The issue may be retained to trace the upstream data problem.
prohibited_use: Do not calculate emissions from the invalid normalized input.

issue_summary: Calculation readiness and factor-matching evidence are internally inconsistent.
recommended_action: Review candidate-factor count, factor ID, factor units, factor status, and readiness logic before recalculation.
allowed_use: The inconsistent records may remain visible for debugging and audit review.
prohibited_use: Do not select a factor silently or report a calculated emissions value.

issue_summary: Natural-gas type NG1 or NG2 is required before the official heating value can be applied.
recommended_action: Confirm whether the activity uses NG1 or NG2. Do not infer the type from company, region, volume, or supplier unless an explicit verified mapping exists.
allowed_use: The activity may remain visible until the natural-gas type is confirmed.
prohibited_use: Do not guess NG1 or NG2 and do not report a calculated result.

issue_summary: A required core-pipeline result is missing, duplicated, orphaned, or conflicts with another stage.
recommended_action: Review record identifiers and regenerate the affected pipeline stages before using the result.
allowed_use: The inconsistency may remain visible as a technical audit exception.
prohibited_use: Do not silently select duplicate rows, ignore missing rows, or treat conflicting statuses as valid.
